**Fix applied to `README.md` (Quick Start, step 3).** The bug: step 3 pointed fresh-host users at `bash deploy.sh`, the Hetzner scp deploy script, instead of `bash install.sh`, the real fresh-host installer. The corrected Quick Start section:

```markdown
